dernierCall.guidanceProchainTrimestre: No quarterly guidance - Lilly guides on a full-year basis only. Management flagged H2 cadence effects: favorable rebate/discount catch-up adjustments from H1 will not repeat, H2 2025 base included the bolus of international Mounjaro launches, and usual seasonality (European summer in Q3, US type 2 diabetes in Q4) is embedded in the guide.
dernierCall.guidanceAnnuelle: FY26 guidance raised for the second time: revenue $85-87B (from $82-85B; low end +$3B, high end +$2B), non-GAAP performance margin 49-50.5% (from 47-48.5%, +2pts at both ends), non-GAAP EPS $35.50-36.50 - a $2.78 raise at the midpoint before absorbing the $3.03 of Q2 acquired IPR&D charges (prior range $35.50-37.00). Expected net-price erosion (end of medical exceptions, CVS formulary return in Q4) is embedded in the guide and expected to be more than offset by volume growth.
pointsCles: Blowout quarter: revenue $22.97B +48% y/y (beat by ~$2.3B) and non-GAAP EPS $8.38 (beat by ~$1.80) despite $3.03 of acquired IPR&D charges; gross margin 86.3% (+1.3pt), non-GAAP performance margin 54.8% (+9pts); Mounjaro+Zepbound $14.9B combined (+$6.3B y/y), oncology+immunology+neuroscience up 121%.

Foundayo (orforglipron) US launch inflecting: all 3 major PBMs secured in June, full DTC campaign launched, prescriptions nearly doubled month-over-month in late July with ~1 in 4 new starts and prescriber base up from 8,000 to 36,000; US T2D submission completed (action expected late 2026), >40 countries under review, global rollout in early 2027; Q2 sales $67M US + $31M UAE.

Medicare GLP-1 Bridge live since July 1: 20M eligible seniors at $50/month out-of-pocket, coverage for Lilly obesity drugs expanded by 35%; ~80% of uptake is injectable and 60-70% of enrollees are new to treatment - offsetting an underlying -9% US price decline (reported -3% on rebate estimate adjustments) that management says is fully embedded in the guide.

Pipeline stacked: retatrutide TRIUMPH-1/2/3 all positive (bariatric-surgery-level weight loss, ~75% knee-OA pain reduction) with US submission targeted Q1 2027 via the contested BLA pathway; VERVE-102 PCSK9 editing cut LDL 62%; Jaypirca BRUIN CLL-322 first Phase 3 win over a venetoclax arm; BD spree into vaccines (Curevo, LimmaTech, Vaccine Company), psychiatry (AtaiBeckley) and in vivo CAR-T (Kelonia).

hypothese.summary: Lilly remains the global GLP-1 leader, with FY26 guidance raised again (revenue $85-87 Md, non-GAAP EPS $35,50-36,50) after a very sharply higher Q2. The 2027-2030 trajectory rests on the ramp-up of the Medicare Bridge and the recently confirmed inflection of Foundayo, tempered by a technically slower H2 2026 (comparison base, non-recurring rebates) and a very active M&A pace that delays deleveraging.
hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
World leader in GLP-1 (Mounjaro/Zepbound) and diabetes/obesity care. Q2 26 amplified the thesis: FY26 guidance RAISED on all three axes (revenue 85-87bn, non-GAAP margin 49-50.5%, EPS 35.50-36.50), the Foundayo (oral GLP-1) launch inflection is now tangible, and the Medicare GLP-1 Bridge has been ramping since 01/07. The 2027-2030 trajectory rests on three penetration engines - Medicare Bridge, Foundayo international, under-penetrated markets - not on naive extrapolation.

== THESIS READ ==
- Foundayo is the marginal thesis driver: an oral GLP-1 changes the capacity and access equation. Watch: Q3 confirmation of the inflection (data still young, noise possible).
- The model deliberately discounts the guided margin (47.5% retained vs 49-50.5% guided) - part of the raise is H1 one-offs per management itself. Watch: H2 margin decomposition.
- Retatrutide: the FDA/BLA litigation path and the Q1 2027 calendar are the main pipeline binaries. Watch: any calendar slip.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Guidance excludes acquired IPR&D booked after 30/06 by construction - yet the M&A rhythm makes such charges recurring: the fiche anchors EPS on the guidance mid while absorbing the recurrence through the margin discount (documented in the bridge's FY25 residual too). Net debt rose vs the prior refresh (M&A) - deleveraging resumes from 2028 in the model.

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
2026: revenue 86bn (guide mid), EBIT margin 47.5% retained, EPS 36.00 (guide mid); 2027-2030: revenue +26%/yr fading to +13%, margin drift to ~47%, ETR 19% normative (FY25 ~25% documented), shares -0.5%/yr. finNet improving with deleveraging then flipping positive. Watch: Foundayo Q3; retatrutide calendar; M&A pace vs deleveraging; IRA pricing dynamics on the franchise.

== CATALYSTS ==
Q3 (late Oct); retatrutide BLA milestones (Q1 27); Foundayo international approvals; obesity reimbursement expansion.

ancrages.moteur: FY26 guidance raised at Q2 (revenue 85-87Md, performance margin 49-50,5%, non-GAAP EPS 35,50-36,50$), driven by GLP-1 demand and by favourable rebate adjustments in H1, partly non-recurring.

Implicit pullback in the growth rate in H2 2026 owing to non-recurring rebate adjustments in H1, a high international comparison base in H2 2025, and the usual seasonality - not a signal of a structural slowdown in demand.
Ramp-up of the Medicare GLP-1 Bridge programme (live since 1 July 2026, +35% access, 60-70% of patients new to treatment) over the full year 2027.

Inflection of the US launch of Foundayo in late July 2026 (prescriptions doubled in one month, prescribers from 8 000 to 36 000) and international expansion still largely ahead in 2027 (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Mexico already approved).

Very active M&A pace (Orna, Ajax, Centessa, Kelonia in Q2; 3 infectious-disease acquisitions and the AtaiBeckley agreement after Q2; +4,5Md$ invested in the Indiana sites), debt-financed, which delays deleveraging relative to the previous trajectory.

BLA filing for retatrutide now targeted for Q1 2027 (ongoing dispute with the FDA over the regulatory pathway), meaning a revenue contribution that can no longer be expected before 2028 at the earliest.
